chunks: Ali ibn Ahmad said: Obaydillah ibn Musa al-Alawi informed us, from al-Hasan ibn Ali, from Abdullah ibn Jibilla, from some of his companions, from Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) that he said:
That matter (the appearance of al-Qa'im) will not occur until a time comes that you spit at the face of each other, curse each other and call each other as liars.

key_terms.ذَلِكَ الْأَمْرُ: That matter (referring to the appearance of al-Qa'im)

ai.seo_question: What are the social signs before the appearance of al-Qa'im?
ai.summary: In this narration from Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him), the breakdown of social cohesion is depicted through escalating interpersonal hostility, serving as a precursor to the emergence of al-Qa'im. This specific sequence of insults—spitting, cursing, and mutual accusation of lying—highlights the deepening fitna (strife) within the Shia community during the Great Disappearance, reflecting the scholarly view that internal discord is a key eschatological marker.
